requirements.item: Maker's name and place of business
Net quantity in oz and g on front

rules.summary: The front panel must state what the food is (statement of identity).
List every ingredient by common name, in descending order of weight.
Show the name and place of business (city, state, ZIP) of the maker, packer or distributor.
Nutrition Facts panel: format, serving size, rounding and % Daily Values.
Net quantity on the principal display panel, in both US customary and metric units.
"No added sugar" only if no sugars or sugar-containing ingredients are added.
Major food allergens (including tree nuts, by type) must be declared.
Use the Certified Vegan mark only when no ingredient is of animal origin (honey included).

sentences.text: Update the US carton for Dancing Fish Granola Berry Crunch, 480 g.
The agency delivers a corrected pack that passes the acceptance checklist below.
Statement of identity: GRANOLA — BERRY CRUNCH.
Net quantity: 480 g.
Servings per container: 8.
Barcode (UPC): 1 20000 00003 6, check digit valid.
Front: statement of identity, net quantity in oz and g, brand name.
Back: ingredient list, allergen statement with a Contains line, maker's name and address, barcode.
Left: Nutrition Facts panel in the US FDA standard vertical format.
Keep: brand name Dancing Fish and the Oven Baked claim.
Change: show the net quantity in oz as well as 480 g on the front.
Add: a Contains statement and the company address (city, state, ZIP).
Remove: the Certified Vegan mark and the No Added Sugar claim.

sections.title: Allowed claims (and removed claims, with reason)

sentences.text: Allowed: Oven Baked.
Removed: Certified Vegan, because the recipe contains honey.
Removed: No Added Sugar, because honey and coconut sugar are added sugars.
Needs proof on file before it stays: GMO Free.
Serving size 85 g, 8 servings per container, 166 kcal per serving.
Total Sugars 18 g, of which Added Sugars 0 g, to be rechecked once honey is counted as added sugar.
Sodium 23 mg is 12% of the Daily Value, so ask R&D for the lab report.
Protein 40 g per serving.
